press_references.value: Mashreq collaborates with Mastercard to expand quick remit cross-border payment corridors

partnership_announcements.description: Mashreq and Mastercard have entered a strategic collaboration to use Mastercard Move to expand Mashreq’s Quick Remit cross‑border payment corridors, enabling Mashreq customers to send local‑currency remittances across new international markets.

press_references.value: Mashreq and Toothpick Launch UAE Digital Healthcare Loans

partnership_announcements.description: Mashreq and healthcare platform Toothpick formed a strategic partnership to embed Mashreq NEO digital healthcare loans into Toothpick’s UAE clinic network, enabling point-of-care financing for dental and aesthetic treatments.

press_references.value: Mashreq sets regional benchmark with SAP Fieldglass

partnership_announcements.description: Mashreq, SAP, apsolut, and Workspend announced a strategic partnership to implement SAP Fieldglass, making Mashreq the first bank in the GCC to deploy all three core modules under a vendor-funded MSP model.

press_references.value: bl interview. India remains a focus market for us: Mashreq India CEO

partnership_announcements.description: Mashreq India is leveraging the India-UAE partnership to support trade and investment between the two countries, benefiting from agreements like the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA).

press_references.value: Mashreq Targets UAE Visitors With NEO On Arrival Digital Account

product_launches.description: Mashreq launched the NEO On Arrival fully digital bank account, enabling UAE visitors to open a virtual account and get a digital card on arrival using passport-based eKYC for immediate local transactions.

press_references.value: Mashreq Launches Money Insights on NEO App to Track Spending and Subscriptions

product_launches.description: Mashreq launched Money Insights, a personal financial management feature within its NEO mobile banking app, enabling UAE customers to track spending, cash flow, and subscriptions with categorized transaction views and month-on-month comparisons.

press_references.value: Mashreq launches first-of-its-kind instant digital cross-border accounts for Egyptians in the UAE

product_launches.description: Mashreq launched a first-of-its-kind instant digital cross-border Mashreq Egypt Account, enabling eligible Egyptian nationals in the UAE to remotely open EGP and USD accounts with seamless, fee-free transfers and unified app management.

press_references.value: Earning Dh15,000 salary? Dubai bank launches first digital home loan pre-approval

product_launches.description: Mashreq launched what it calls the first fully digital browser-based home loan pre-approval service in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, allowing salaried residents earning at least Dh15,000 to obtain same-day verified mortgage pre-approval online.

press_references.value: PM opens UAE digital bank to foster cashless economy

product_launches.description: Mashreq Bank launched its Mashreq Digital Retail Bank service in Pakistan, introducing a new digital banking offering aimed at promoting cashless transactions and financial inclusion.

press_references.value: Mashreq launches NEO PLUS saver account for salary and non-salary customers

product_launches.description: Mashreq has launched the NEO PLUS Saver Account, a high-interest digital savings product for both salary and non-salary customers, offering market-leading returns and digital access through its mobile app.

press_references.value: Mashreq to foster Egypt’s digital corporate banking landscape via NEO Corp launch

product_launches.description: A digital corporate banking platform offering cash management, trade services, and real-time insights.

overview_description.description:
Mashreq has provided banking and financial services to millions of customers and businesses since 1967. 

They are one of UAE's leading financial institutions with a growing retail presence in the region including Egypt, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain. They focus on providing their customers access to a wide range of innovative products and services.

about_short_description.short_description: Mashreq is a banking and financial services platform.

product.name: Personal Banking
product.description: Banking services for individuals, including current and savings accounts, deposits, personal loans, home finance, credit cards, and digital banking access.

product.name: Corporate and Investment Banking
product.description: Financial services for large companies, institutions, and government-related entities, including lending, capital markets, advisory, and structured finance.

product.name: Business Banking
product.description: Banking and financing services for small and medium-sized enterprises, including business accounts, working-capital finance, trade services, cards, and digital tools.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Online and mobile banking services for opening accounts, managing finances, making payments, transferring funds, and accessing banking products remotely.

product.name: Cards and Payments
product.description: Debit, credit, prepaid, and commercial card products for purchases, cash access, expense management, and electronic payments.

product.name: Trade Finance and Transaction Banking
product.description: Trade, cash-management, and working-capital services that help companies manage collections, payments, liquidity, guarantees, letters of credit, and cross-border commerce.
